scope: Part 2 in full (ss 2 to 7: the mediation gateway, the seven time limits in s 3(2), the listing requirements in s 3(3), the claim referral certificate, and settlement) and Part 3 Divisions 2 to 4 (ss 12 to 16, 21, 22, 23, 24, 27 and 28: jurisdiction, lodging, the no-division rule, abandonment of the excess, the one-forum rules, evidence, orders, appeal, and contracting out). NOT ENCODED: Part 3 Division 1 (ss 8 to 11, which constitute the tribunals and make appointments), ss 17 to 20 and 22's detail on procedure, ss 29 to 35. NO REGULATIONS OR RULES OF COURT WERE RETRIEVED, and the Act leaves to them: which employees and employers may use the tribunal (s 12(2) and (8)), the claim limits (s 12(7) and (8)(e)), the period for lodging a claim after a certificate issues (s 12(6)), the mediation fee, and the manner of submission. The claim limits are exercised in the cases using EXPLICITLY INVENTED figures, labelled as such; the figures commonly cited for them are not encoded because they were not read.
